m.title: the Severer
m.doom_desc:
A malevolent fate is gathering around you. If your Doom reaches 100%, you will be afflicted by a random bane and your Doom will reset to 0. Banes have diverse negative effects that can significantly endanger your character for an extended period of time.

Both Doom and Banes are only cured by gaining experience, though Banes typically last much longer.

status.desc: You are poisoned and will continually lose health. While poisoned, your current health will be partially recoloured to display the eventual poison damage that will be dealt. Poison can be cured immediately by potions of curing.
Your maximum health has been temporarily drained by negative energy. This status will not wear off by waiting, but will gradually expire as you gain experience.
